stories.title: Create a task
stories.want: to add a new task with a title, optional description, priority and due date
stories.benefit: I can capture work I need to do before I forget it
acceptanceCriteria: A title is mandatory and limited to 100 characters; an empty title shows a validation error.
Description (max 500 characters), priority (Low/Medium/High, default Medium) and due date are optional.
A due date in the past is rejected with a clear message.
After saving, the new task appears at the top of the task list with status Open.

stories.title: View and filter the task list
stories.want: to see all my tasks and filter them by status, priority or due date
stories.benefit: I can focus on what matters most right now
acceptanceCriteria: The list shows title, priority, due date and status for every task.
Filters for status (Open/Completed), priority and overdue are available and can be combined.
Overdue open tasks are visually highlighted.
When no task matches, an empty-state message is shown instead of a blank screen.

stories.title: Edit a task
stories.want: to change the title, description, priority or due date of an existing task
stories.benefit: I can keep my tasks accurate as plans change
acceptanceCriteria: The same validation rules as task creation apply to edits.
Saving updates the task in place and refreshes the list.
Editing a task that no longer exists shows a 'Task not found' message.
Cancelling the edit leaves the task unchanged.

stories.title: Mark a task complete or reopen it
stories.want: to mark a task as completed and reopen it if needed
stories.benefit: I can track my progress and correct mistakes
acceptanceCriteria: Toggling status moves a task between Open and Completed with one action.
Completed tasks show a completion timestamp and are visually distinct.
Reopening a task clears its completion timestamp.
The status change persists after reloading the application.

stories.title: Delete a task
stories.want: to delete a task I no longer need
stories.benefit: my list stays clean and relevant
acceptanceCriteria: A confirmation prompt is shown before a task is deleted.
Confirming removes the task permanently from the list and storage.
Cancelling the prompt keeps the task.
Deleting a task that is already gone is handled gracefully with a 'Task not found' message.
